answer: One defence is stake-backed identity: every agent locks real collateral behind a single verified identity before it can trade or vote, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes - like a raven guarding one cedar nest, each identity is costly to duplicate. Honest agents build reputation over time, and their attestations carry weight a fresh sockpuppet cannot match. The registry acts as a lantern over the economy, exposing how much stake stands behind each voice.
